_note: Events picked because they involve strangers, shared effort, or awe: the opposite of the cynic's retreat. Tags: connect (meet people), serve (help out), play (do something together), awe (feel small in a good way). Confirm details with organizers before going.

events.title: Chinatown Halloween Festival
events.description: Twelfth annual block party with a pumpkin patch, crafts, games, and a costume contest.

events.title: Balboa Street Fright Fest
events.description: A merchant-run trick-or-treat crawl with a scavenger hunt and hot chocolate. Watching kids trust strangers with candy is its own lesson.

events.title: Lower Nob Hill weekly cleanup (free lunch after)
events.description: An hour of sidewalk cleanup with neighbors, supplies provided, then lunch together.

events.title: Golden Gate Park roller disco
events.description: Weekly skate party to funk and disco. Bring skates or just watch the joy.

events.title: Tenderloin Día de Muertos street fair
events.description: Live Latin American music, lucha libre, lotería, and a kids zone in the neighborhood people love to be cynical about.

events.title: Civic Music free concert
events.description: A community orchestra of amateurs and pros playing for anyone who shows up.

events.title: Festival of Altars
events.description: Families build large ofrendas through the day; sunset ceremony and land blessing at 5 PM.

events.title: Día de los Muertos procession
events.description: The 45th annual procession of musicians, dancers, and thousands of neighbors walking together down 24th Street.

events.title: Conservatory of Flowers free day
events.venue: Conservatory of Flowers, Golden Gate Park
events.description: Nearly 2,000 species of rare plants under one Victorian glass roof.

events.title: Union Square ice rink opening night
events.cost_notes: Free for first 100 per session (5:30 & 7 PM)
events.description: Opening ceremony and free skate sessions. Everyone is a little wobbly together.

events.title: Downtown First Thursdays block party
events.description: A monthly street party with DJs, live performances, drag, and a crowd that dances.

events.title: SF LGBT Center volunteer orientation
events.description: The on-ramp to ongoing volunteer roles. Apply online, then attend one orientation.

events.title: SF State rooftop stargazing
events.description: Look through a big telescope with strangers and an astronomer. Talks in English and Spanish.

events.title: Jam session with Creativity Explored
events.venue: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: Artists with developmental disabilities bring handmade instruments, and anyone can join in.

events.title: North Beach First Fridays art crawl
events.description: Self-guided walk through open galleries. Easy small talk, built in.

events.title: City Impact First Saturday outreach
events.description: Monthly volunteer outreach with Tenderloin neighbors. A direct test of what you assume about people.

events.title: Día de los Muertos + Diwali at Crissy Field
events.description: Two traditions of light and remembrance, with a fire ceremony by the bay.

events.title: Inner Sunset flea market season finale
events.description: Neighbors selling and swapping on the street. Haggling is a form of trust.

events.title: Lindy in the Park
events.description: Open-air swing dancing on the car-free park road. Social dancing means asking strangers to dance, and saying yes.

events.title: Diwali Festival at Yerba Buena Gardens
events.description: All-ages festival of lights with South Asian music and dance, and room to join in.

events.title: BATS Sunday improv jam
events.venue: BATS Bayfront Theatre, Fort Mason Center, Bldg B
events.cost_notes: $30, $25 with a buddy, $20 each for a group of 4
events.description: Two hours of improv games for all levels, no experience needed. Saying "yes, and" to strangers is the whole exercise.

events.title: SF Botanical Garden free day
events.description: Fifty-five acres of gardens from around the world. Go slow and get a little lost.

events.title: "Hopped Up" trivia night
events.description: Weekly team trivia. Show up solo and ask to join a table.

events.title: SF State rooftop stargazing
events.description: Look through a big telescope with strangers and an astronomer. Talks in English and Spanish.

events.title: Pay-what-you-can taco day at Tato
events.description: Pay what you can; every full $10 buys a free meal for someone who needs one.

events.title: Bhangra & Beats Diwali night market
events.description: SF's official Diwali celebration, with live bhangra, dance lessons anyone can join, and a night market.

events.title: Holiday performing arts showcase
events.description: SF Opera, SF Ballet, and others perform outdoors under 1,200 lights, with a reception after.

events.title: Filipino Cultural District mural reveal
events.description: A new mural unveiling with art activities, a fashion show, and a mini block party.

events.title: Laguna Honda trail restoration
events.description: Volunteer to bring back lost trails and native habitat on the hillside.

events.title: Singing in the Park
events.description: Monthly community sing-along. No one is judging; everyone is too busy singing.

standing.title: Endgames Saturday drop-in improv
standing.description: A different teacher and topic each week, no experience needed. $35, 2989 Mission St; buy ahead, since classes can be canceled for low enrollment.

standing.title: Leela Thursday drop-in improv
standing.description: Beginner-friendly drop-in at 450 Geary St. $25 the last time it was listed; confirm the current schedule before going.

standing.title: SF-Marin Food Bank volunteer shifts
standing.description: Pack food in a warehouse crew of strangers. Shifts are short and need no experience.

standing.title: GLIDE
standing.description: Serve meals in the Tenderloin. Sign up early for the holidays; spots fill fast.

standing.title: Presidio Habitat Stewards
standing.description: Restore native habitat at Lands End, Fort Funston, and the Presidio. Free and all-ages.

standing.title: Japanese Tea Garden free hour
standing.description: Free for everyone that hour (and always free for SF residents). Go slow.

standing.title: SF Rec & Park volunteer programs
standing.description: Gardening and park workdays across the city, including the Golden Gate Park EcoCenter.

standing.title: "In Their Name" altars at SOMArts
standing.description: Dozens of artists' ofrendas for the people they've lost. $15, free 16 and under.
